title: Expense reimbursement portal
objective: Replace emailed expense spreadsheets with a secure, traceable reimbursement workflow.

stories.title: Submit a complete expense claim
stories.capability: submit a business expense with receipt evidence
stories.benefit: my reimbursement can enter review without email or spreadsheets
stories.narrative: As an employee, I want to submit a business expense with receipt evidence, so that my reimbursement can enter review without email or spreadsheets.
stories.business_value: Creates a complete, traceable claim and removes manual spreadsheet intake.
stories.description: An employee builds a private draft, validates required claim data and receipts, and submits exactly once to the manager captured at submission.

acceptance_criteria.title: Save an incomplete draft
given: the claim belongs to the employee
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee saves a partially completed claim
then: the draft is retained
the claim is not sent for review
validation identifies fields still required for submission

acceptance_criteria.title: Submit a valid claim exactly once
given: at least one PDF, PNG, or JPEG receipt of at most 10 MB is attached
the amount is greater than zero
the expense date is not in the future
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee submits the claim and retries after a network timeout
then: one claim enters pending manager review
the employee-editable version is frozen
status and submission time are visible
no duplicate claim is created

acceptance_criteria.title: Reject invalid submission
given: a required field or valid receipt is missing
then: the claim remains a draft
each validation error is associated with its field
focus moves to an accessible error summary

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Receipt files are encrypted in transit and at rest.
non_functional_requirements.measure: TLS is enforced and storage encryption is verified in the deployment configuration.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Submission and validation support WCAG 2.2 AA keyboard and screen-reader use.
non_functional_requirements.measure: Automated checks plus keyboard and screen-reader acceptance testing pass.

data_requirements: Retain receipt metadata separately from claim fields
assumptions: The current manager can be resolved at submission time
risks: A retry without an idempotency key could create duplicate claims
open_questions: Which currencies and conversion-rate source are supported?
test_notes: Exercise duplicate submission with the same idempotency key
Test 10 MB boundary and unsupported file types
definition_of_done: Security and accessibility evidence is attached

citations.excerpt: Submitting freezes the employee-editable version and sends the claim to the employee's current manager.

stories.title: Approve or reject a direct report's claim
stories.benefit: valid expenses progress and rejected claims return with actionable feedback
stories.narrative: As a manager, I want to review an assigned expense claim, so that valid expenses progress and rejected claims return with actionable feedback.
stories.business_value: Creates accountable approval while preventing self-approval and lost concurrent decisions.
stories.description: The assigned manager reviews the frozen submission, approves it, or rejects it with a mandatory explanation.

acceptance_criteria.title: Approve an assigned claim
given: the manager was captured as reviewer at submission
the manager is not the claimant
then: status becomes approved
the decision actor and time are visible
an immutable audit event records the state change

acceptance_criteria.title: Require a rejection explanation
acceptance_criteria.when: the manager rejects without a comment
then: the rejection is not saved
an accessible required-comment error is shown

acceptance_criteria.title: Prevent self-review and stale overwrite
given: the manager is the claimant or another reviewer already completed the decision
then: no claim state is changed
the response explains that review is not permitted or the claim has changed
the completed audit history remains unchanged

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Authorization is checked on every review request, not only in the UI.
non_functional_requirements.measure: API tests prove unassigned and self-review requests cannot change state.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Concurrent decisions do not overwrite a completed decision.
non_functional_requirements.measure: A stale version produces a conflict response and no second state transition.

ux_requirements: Show receipt evidence without exposing unrelated employee claims
data_requirements: Record previous and new state in audit event
assumptions: Pending claims retain the manager captured at submission
risks: Reporting-line changes can leave claims assigned to departed managers
open_questions: Who can reassign a claim when a manager leaves?
test_notes: Run simultaneous approval and rejection requests

citations.excerpt: A manager cannot review their own claim. Concurrent review attempts must not overwrite a completed decision.

stories.title: Export approved unpaid claims safely
stories.benefit: finance can process reimbursements from a complete and auditable dataset
stories.narrative: As a finance analyst, I want to export approved unpaid claims, so that finance can process reimbursements from a complete and auditable dataset.
stories.business_value: Provides a controlled finance handoff without exposing receipt content.
stories.description: Finance exports the specified approved-claim fields as CSV with formula-safe text and an immutable export audit event.

acceptance_criteria.title: Export the approved unpaid population
given: the actor has the finance analyst role
acceptance_criteria.when: the analyst requests a CSV export
then: the file contains only approved unpaid claims
all PRD-specified columns are present
receipt content is absent
an export audit event records actor, time, and claim scope

acceptance_criteria.title: Prevent spreadsheet formula execution
given: an exported textual field begins with equals, plus, minus, or at-sign
then: the value is neutralized as text
the original business value remains recognizable

acceptance_criteria.title: Deny unauthorized export
given: the actor lacks the finance analyst role
acceptance_criteria.when: the export endpoint is requested directly
then: access is denied
no export file is created
no claim data is returned

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Ordinary portal requests meet the agreed response target.
non_functional_requirements.measure: At least 95 percent complete within two seconds under the agreed load profile; export receives a separate volume budget.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Export excludes receipt content and unauthorized claims.
non_functional_requirements.measure: Automated field and authorization tests pass for every export.

ux_requirements: Explain the included claim population before download
data_requirements: Retain audit events for seven years
Prevent application edits to audit records
analytics_requirements: Measure export count, duration, row count, and failures without claim content
assumptions: CSV is the initial finance handoff format
risks: Large exports need a separate asynchronous design and performance budget
open_questions: What is the approved-claim payment integration?
What export volume must be supported?
definition_of_ready: Expected volume and payment handoff are agreed
definition_of_done: CSV contract and authorization tests pass

citations.excerpt: Finance can export approved, unpaid claims as CSV. Receipt content is not included.

cross_cutting_requirements: Role checks apply at every API boundary.
Every state transition produces an immutable audit event.
Credentials, receipt content, and payment data are excluded from logs and model prompts.

glossary.claim: An employee's grouped expense data and receipt evidence.
glossary.pending: Submitted and awaiting the manager captured at submission.
glossary.approved unpaid: Manager-approved and not yet recorded as paid by finance.

assumptions: The organization provides authoritative employee, manager, and role data.
unresolved_questions: Who can reassign a claim when a manager leaves?
Which currencies and conversion-rate source are supported?
What payment integration and export volume are required?
